column3: “Sons did not belong to them” is rendered “had no sons.”
“Their group” is rendered “their offices,” and “service” as “ministry.”
“To the chiefs of the men” is rendered “chief men”; NASB supplies “thus” and “there were.”
“These with these” is rendered “the one as the other,” and “officials of holiness” as “officers of the sanctuary.”
“Officials” is rendered “princes.” The Hebrew repeats “drawn” for Ithamar; NASB has “one taken for Ithamar,” and the exact sense is uncertain.
“Groups” is rendered “offices,” and “by the hand of Aaron” as “given to them through Aaron.” “Ancestor” is rendered “father.”
The Hebrew has only “and the sons, Jeriah”; NASB supplies “of Hebron” and “the first,” as in 23:19.
“Not belonged to him sons” is rendered “who had no sons.”
